identity.findings: Peggy Kamuf 身份无误：USC Dornsife French and Italian and Comparative Literature 荣休教授、德里达英译者与遗稿受托人。

sources.title: USC News（we-are.usc.edu，2023-08-03）："USC Dornsife scholar Peggy Kamuf elected to the British Academy"
sources.readScope: 全文通读：其头衔（Professor Emerita of French and Italian and Comparative Literature）、1986年以法语教授身份加入USC Dornsife；当选英国学术院院士（英国人文与社会科学国家学术院、1902年成立、院士逾1600名）；本年度共86位学者获选；获选理由为『distinguished and continuing achievements in original research』；其本人感言（『I'm proud to be recognized by such a prestigious institution』）；文末链接至Dornsife详报（本轮403未读）。英国学术院2023-07-21原始公告页仍403/快照未取到，本条以大学正式公告替代承担该断言。
